hermes-hands 0.0.0-dev  ·  <TMP>
hermes-agent · session (pending — confirmed on the first turn)
/help  /new  /sessions  /check  /exit

hermes-hands - session <SESSION> >   Type a message to your Hermes brain. It works this directory through
  you — local_shell, local_read, local_write, local_edit in <TMP>,
  each with your approval.
    /new          start a fresh session in this directory
    /session      show this session's detail (turns, tokens, splits)
    /session <id> switch to another session  (ids from /sessions)
    /sessions     list this machine's sessions  (/sessions -v: each with its hermes-agent session)
    /history      replay this session (/history <n> = last n turns, /history <id> = another)
    /out <n>      full output of call #n
    /fork         branch this session on the server, switch to it
    /compact      compact this session's chat now (a chat checkpoint; outputs stay readable)
    /context      what Hermes reads now (/context full = every message)
    /yolo         toggle approvals for shell / write / edit
    /debug        toggle the redacted connection trace (session debug.jsonl)
    /setup        (re)configure the gateway URL + key
    /config       config file path + effective settings (read-only; edit by hand)
    /check        re-test the gateway connection
    /help         show this
    /exit         quit  (Ctrl-D too; Ctrl-C cancels the running turn)
